body:
Addressed in e6f730ad1: the re-pin branch now calls `activateProviderProfile({ name: globalConfigName })` instead of `saveViewState("currentApiConfigName", globalConfigName)`. Activation refreshes the view's provider settings, so the view adopts the shared selection's provider settings instead of continuing on the invalid profile's stale apiConfiguration while reporting the re-pinned name. The activation writes the shared slot back with the same value, so the global selection itself is untouched. Both re-pin launch tests updated: activation called once with the shared selection, no name-only saveViewState, and the shared selection is not re-written to a different profile. (Same fix as the F2 PR #1555, 5a87f9071 — this branch predates it.)

Validation: tsc --noEmit exit 0; 11 suites 611/611 on the merged tree (parallelMode, webviewMessageHandler, api-set-configuration, ClineProvider, sticky-profile, sticky-mode, importExport, switchModeTool, Task, ClineProvider.delegation, nested-delegation-resume); eslint --max-warnings=0 exit 0 on the touched files; no suppression count changes. Pushed with the main-first merge 9bf83e322.
